description: SEC Piotroski F-score + Altman Z'' — Financial-health screen for any US-GAAP SEC filer from EDGAR XBRL 10-K data: Piotroski F-score (9 pass/fail tests: ROA, cash flow, ROA change, accruals, leverage, current ratio, dilution, gross margin, asset turnover) plus Altman Z'' (book-equity bankruptcy-risk model, SAFE/GREY/DISTRESS) and an overall verdict FINANCIALLY STRONG / STABLE / WATCH / DISTRESS RISK, with every input number. ticker= or cik=. Banks get the F-score without Z''. Example: /v1/sec/fscore?ticker=AAPL Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_fscore
